research_rationale: The frozen dossier supplies ACTOR_TEXT:EO:12855 despite retaining the machine missing-provision warning. Reading it resolves that old omission: July 19, 1993 replaces section 3(d) completely with Interior support and changes the agency in section 4(a); it is not a whole-order termination. EO13053 later changes these agencies to Energy. The original two-year Council term was actually extended by EO12965 until June 29, 1997; EO13053 is dated June 30, 1997 and replaces that date with February 28, 1999; EO13114 timely replaces the latter with June 30, 1999. The packet supplies no retroactive effective wording for EO13053. Thus exact first cessation cannot simply be assigned June 30, 1999 without resolving whether the June 29/June 30 boundary was continuous or a lapse followed by renewed authority. EO13138 section 3(f) revokes the amended order effective September 30, 1999 and describes the committee as previously terminated; it does not date or resolve that earlier boundary. The original section 4(c) revocation of EO12737 is an executed legal act whose historical effect must be distinguished from live Council obligations. No express savings of an independent continuing Council command appears.
unresolved_material_gaps: Resolve the exact first-cessation effect of EO12965’s June 29, 1997 endpoint followed by EO13053 dated June 30, 1997; the held actor text has no retroactive effective language. A June 30, 1999 first-end assertion would assume continuity across that actual date boundary.
